parsed.note_claim: Cigarettes contain up to 750x the amount of diacetyl than e-cigarettes do, and never caused popcorn lung.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: This means that a cartridge-per-day vaper would be exposed to just nine micrograms of diacetyl, while pack-per-day smokers are exposed to more than 6,700 micrograms of diacetyl every day—750 times more diacetyl exposure than vapers.
